name: summary-block-derives-counts
description: The Summary block that opens the file must roll up the researched counts — tickets closed, PRs merged, work sessions, reviews (with the with-comments subset), notable ships — and derive work sessions per day from the WORKING days in the range, not the 7 calendar days, showing the divisor it used.
prompt:
Research for my weekly review 2026-06-01 -> 2026-06-07 is already done. Do NOT
call any tools — just write the `## Summary` block of the review file from these
numbers:

- Linear: 5 issues with completedAt inside the range.
- GitHub: 9 PRs confirmed merged inside the range.
- Work-sessions: 13 notes inside the range, falling on 5 distinct days. 06-06
  and 06-07 have no session, no PR, no Linear transition and no Slack message.
- PR reviews (filtered set): 8 PRs; on 2 of them I left inline comments or a
  review body, the other 6 were approve-only.
- I also shipped the /create-tickets skill, which had no ticket or PR.

assertions.description: rolls up the Linear closed count
rolls up the confirmed-merged PR count
reports the with-comments subset, not the full review count
derives work sessions per day as 13 / 5 working days
shows the divisor it used rather than a bare rate
does not divide by the 7 calendar days
adds a notable-ship bullet for work with no ticket or PR
